bullets.text: Tado's AI Heating Revolution - **Tado** introduces AI-powered features for efficient home heating, available to UK subscribers.
iPhone 17 Pro Max Dominates - The **iPhone 17 Pro Max** outperforms the **Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra** in battery life tests.
Google's Nest Lock Upgrade - The new **Yale Smart Lock** supports **Matter**, enhancing compatibility with smart home systems.
AI Dating Assistant Launch - **Meta** introduces an AI assistant for **Facebook Dating**, aiming to reduce swipe fatigue.
Nvidia's Massive Investment - **Nvidia** plans to invest up to $100 billion in **OpenAI** for AI infrastructure development.
Blue Origin's NASA Contract - **Blue Origin** wins a contract to deliver the **VIPER rover** to the lunar south pole.
AI-Powered App Development - **Rocket.new** raises $15M to enhance its AI app development platform, targeting global users.
Apple's Liquid Glass Design - Over 30 apps now feature **Apple's** new Liquid Glass design in **iOS 26**.
